name: Havilah
overview: Havilah is a male figure identified in Scripture as a son of Joktan. There is no tribal affiliation or additional notes recorded about him. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical, grounding him within the post-Flood generations.
namesAndTitles: The name Havilah appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:29. No specific meaning or divine origin of the name is given in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Havilah as a son of Joktan, establishing his place in the genealogy of Joktan's descendants. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other familial connections are detailed.
scriptureSignificance: Havilah's significance lies in his inclusion in the genealogical record of Genesis 10, which traces the descendants of Noah's sons. As a son of Joktan, Havilah contributes to the biblical account of the repopulation of the earth after the Flood. His mention helps preserve the historical lineage important for understanding the dispersion of nations as outlined in Scripture.
